meta.name: seo-strategy
meta.description: Audits and improves organic search performance — technical health, site architecture, internal linking, structured data, and the content decisions that determine what can rank. Use this to run an SEO audit, diagnose why pages are not ranking or were deindexed, plan a site's URL and navigation structure, add structured data, or prioritize which SEO fixes are worth doing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断网站搜索排名问题并制定优化方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有网站但自然搜索流量上不去
copy.tagline_en: Audit your site's organic search and plan fixes to boost rankings.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a website but organic search traffic is flat.

howto.what: Claude 按固定顺序诊断网站，覆盖抓取与索引、搜索意图匹配、排名权重、架构与内链、性能、结构化数据；最终按严重程度列出问题与证据、修复顺序、预期影响，以及选择不修的内容。
howto.when: 当你说要做 SEO 审计、诊断页面为何没排名或被移除索引，或规划网站 URL 与导航结构等时接管。

say.text: 帮我审计 example.com，按严重程度列出 SEO 问题。
say.note: 会按顺序检查并输出分级发现与修复清单。

say.text: 首页搜不到，帮我查是不是 noindex 或 canonical 指错了。
say.note: 会先检查索引状态和重复页面问题。

howto.what_en: Audits in order: crawlability, indexing, intent match, authority, architecture and internal links, performance, structured data. Returns severity-ranked findings with evidence, fix list, expected impact, and what is not fixed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for an SEO audit, ask why pages are not ranking or were deindexed, or ask to plan URL and navigation structure.

say_en.text: Audit example.com and list SEO issues by severity.
say_en.note: Runs the diagnostic order, returning findings and a fix sequence.

say_en.text: The homepage is missing from search. Check for noindex or wrong canonicals.
say_en.note: Inspects index state and duplicate causes first.

say_en.text: Add Article JSON-LD to the article pages on example.com.
say_en.note: Outputs JSON-LD code for the page head.
